t: A mini-ITX RISC-V motherboard with an AI engine for desktop builds.
steps: Check the Milk-V Megrez page for official agents. Launch prices were 199 US dollars for 16 GB.
Gather a mini-ITX case, an ATX power supply or 12 V adapter, and a microSD card or SATA SSD.
Download a RockOS or Fedora image from the Megrez resources page.
Write the image to your card or drive with a free tool such as balenaEtcher.
Connect an HDMI monitor, a keyboard, and a network cable.
Boot up and log in to the desktop.
Install Jupyter and run a first Python notebook.
